name: Dream-Gazer

source.note: A side quest creature of our own (The Amber Debt, docs/story/side_quests.md), from the gazer of the beholder's lore: a tiny eye the Eye Below dreams up. Drawn with the beholder's sprite, small.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dream-gazer makes two attacks, using Frost Ray or Bite in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d2 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Frost Ray
actions.summary: A thin ray of cold at a foe up to 60 ft away.
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

summary: A floating eye the size of a fist, with a mouth full of needles and four little eyestalks: something a sleeping beholder dreamed, which didn't stop when it woke.
